primary_metric: signed Pearson r squared, separately per section and inspection
aggregate: Unweighted mean of per-profile r² within each case; aggregate undefined if any predeclared profile is undefined. Minimum 3 rows, flag profiles under 10 rows as weak.
evidence_status: Previously viewed development diagnostics. No independent final holdout.

baseline.selection: Documented defaults in README Next cycle and corresponding official assembly in this checkout

S1.design: Fit-eligible historical same-section forecast from earlier VTD. S1A is zero-fit. Fitted future candidates must keep held-section splits inside the campaign, unless evaluated separately on an additional protocol.

S2.design: Cold start leaving one simple section out of one parent/campaign. Not independent cross-parent or temporal evidence.

batch_01.H01: Use only independently verified, pre-cutoff coordinate ties; date-T neighbour and density matches to validation labels cannot establish an admissible candidate.
batch_01.H02: Check local raw hash against preprocessing manifest. Independently reparse Distance, residual thickness and defect depth percent by source_record_number, using the confirmed 2018 fraction rule. Budget one verified correction or report already applied/undetermined.
batch_01.H03: Require dated construction map and confirmed local nominal by weld/segment. VTD wall observations alone do not establish replacement/material identity.
batch_01.H04: Single exact, predeclared category: remove transverse-weld planar discontinuity records from historical VTD features and S2 fold training, while keeping validation keys and measured minima immutable.
batch_01.H05: S1 only: require confirmed comparable eligible UZT with date and position. No learned overlay on ineligible readings.
